short.description: Optional row name, a few words

short_time.description: Optional row time, e.g. '4:40 AM daily'. Else derived from schedule_plain

group.description: Standard: Reports, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Event/Listener, Paused. Any other name is a custom group, shown after the standard ones.

schedule_plain.description: Plain words, ICT, e.g. 'Daily At 4:47 AM ICT'

last_run.description: Plain ICT, e.g. 'Today 4:51 AM' or 'Oct 13, 6:07 PM'
